{{Quote|The ritual I performed was too much power too quickly. I am disintegrating rapidly. I have begun to drain parts of my power into holocrons, though it is only a temporary solution.|Darth Iratus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Darth Iratus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was dead before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He divided his time between [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], performing a forbidden ritual on Belsavis that could heal a fractured body and keeping writings of this technique.

Iratus possessed too much power that rapidly decayed his body as a result of the [[Force walk|Force-walking ritual]]. Though placing his power within [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] was a temporary measure, Iratus sought out the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Mother Machine]] on Belsavis to find a cure to his ailment. However, he perished at the [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] of [[Rakatan guardian droid]]s while attempting to gain access to the device.

Nonetheless, Iratus' holocrons came into the possession of [[Darth Thanaton]], placed within [[Darth Thanaton's private library|his private library]], which Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] broke into in order to find Iratus' journals for a similar problem.
